excluded_source_fields.Killed: Prediction target; never included in feature extraction/model matrix.
excluded_source_fields.Origin_program: Used only to exclude whole groups in folds and to report origin support.
excluded_source_fields.Unnamed: 0: Used only as a traceability join key; not a model feature.
excluded_source_fields.local gate neighborhood / control-target: Not extracted because source-QASM decomposition and the published position index do not establish an unambiguous pre-mutation neighbor mapping.
excluded_source_fields.original/replacement gate reconstruction: QASM is already source-compiled/decomposed; original mutation gate semantics are not reliably recoverable from these artifacts, so no reconstructed gate pair is claimed.
excluded_source_fields.simulation/measurement outcomes: Not used; post-outcome behavior is excluded.

existing_metadata_feature_inventory.note: Source-column definitions, types, missingness/cardinality, availability, and training-partition associations for existing metadata inputs.

extraction.depth_policy: ASAP per-wire native gate layers; barriers synchronize; measurements excluded
